description: For every proof presentation \(P\), \(B_P(n,s)=1\) if and only if \(\exists p\le s\;\operatorname{Check}_P(p,n)=1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.stage_spec
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.ProofPresentation) (n s : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.stage P n s = true ↔ ∃ p ≤ s, P.check p n = true
